# Beyond Elevation

> Beyond Elevation places exited C-suite operators into fractional executive seats, with AI systems running underneath them. It fills exactly three seats: Chief Financial Officer, Chief IP Officer, and AI Operations. Founded and run by Hayat Amin, a three-time exited founder and three-time FT 100 CxO with twenty years in the C-suite across New York, London and Dubai.

## What it does
- /cfo: Fractional CFO + AI. Month end closed in days, cash, margin and runway answered live, board packs built from source data.
- /ip: Fractional Chief IP Officer + AI. Prices, clusters and licenses patents, data and know-how. Not a law firm.
- /fde: AI Operations. One operator wires finance, sales, operations and people functions to AI inside the client's stack.

## Key facts
- Only exited operators: every operator has built a company and sold it.
- Engagement models: fixed 8-week project, or fractional 1–2 days a week.
- Clients own everything built: code, agents, accounts, documentation.
- First step is a free 20-minute call: https://beyondelevation.com/call/me
- Contact: hayat@beyondelevation.com, +1 571 380 7699, +44 7476 383531
- Locations: New York, London, Dubai.
